tool_args.rationale: The acquired wide-gradient measurements resolve the pilot's vmax/rho collinearity; all seven measurements are fit numerically within the supplied wide fallback bounds. The previous attempt failed because its prediction path referenced an undefined training-row global; this version stores fitted parameters in fit() and predict() uses that fitted state.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Not needed: the seven rows provide broad s_grad leverage and identify the three-parameter siphon-plus-sqrt model.
The response rises monotonically and the s_grad dependence is pronounced, unlike a present-snapshot curve depending only on u_now.
The observed open-branch behavior and supplied monotone-concave signature support the signed sqrt branch; this alternative is unnecessary to fit the resolved dataset.
